title: 新

sentences.text: 我不認為他知道怎麼做。
sentences.spokenText: 我不認為他知道怎麼做
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L226-S01 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl, shown as a slightly older child, watches a small child try to fold plain colored paper; the small child can hold and fold paper but is clearly struggling, with messy folded paper on the table.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; small child is younger but not a baby, with a different face, short hair, and simple green top. L058 is style reference only, not a face or clothing reference.
Composition: centered table activity, both children fully visible, messy paper clear, protagonist girl's thoughtful expression clear, safe margins for phone square crop.
Style: warm hand-painted watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft edges and friendly expressions.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, instructional diagrams, step labels, captions, logos, watermarks, readable marks, or paper writing.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩作為比較大的孩子，看著一位小小孩在摺紙，小小孩拿著紙想摺但明顯摺不起來，紙有點亂，主角小女孩在旁邊露出「他可能不知道怎麼做」的表情。畫面要表現「看著別人不太會做」，不要出現文字、數字、教學圖、摺紙步驟標籤。

sentences.text: 新同學不知道走錯路了。
sentences.spokenText: 新同學不知道走錯路了
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L226-S02 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A new classmate wearing a backpack walks the wrong way near a school hallway or school entrance, looking unsure and not yet realizing the route is wrong; the correct direction is implied visually by open doors and other students far away, without any signs.
Visual cast: new classmate is a child with a distinct look from the protagonist family, short dark hair, orange jacket, navy backpack; optional distant teacher or students stay in the background and do not point or guide. L058 is style reference only.
Composition: new classmate centered, wrong direction clear through hallway perspective, safe margins, no visual clutter.
Style: warm watercolor children's school illustration, gentle and non-scary.
Avoid: no text, numbers, classroom signs, road signs, class plates, labels, arrows with text, logos, watermarks, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 新同學背著書包，走在學校附近或校園走廊，方向明顯走偏了，遠處可看到正確方向的教室或校門，但不能用文字標示。新同學表情茫然，還不知道自己走錯路。人物身份：新同學；必要時可有遠處的老師或其他學生作背景，但不要讓他們指路。不可有路牌文字、班級牌、數字或標籤。

sentences.text: 新衣服太大，要拿去改一改。
sentences.spokenText: 新衣服太大要拿去改一改
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L226-S03 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl holds or wears a visibly oversized new plain shirt or dress, with sleeves or body clearly too long; protagonist mother gently checks the clothing and prepares to take it for alteration.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket or pink hair clip, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes; protagonist mother with white/beige blouse, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair. Family continuity from L154/L162/L163; L058 style only, no copied L058 people.
Composition: centered mother and girl, oversized clothing obvious, plain measuring tape and sewing tools visible but without markings, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor family-life illustration, friendly expressions.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, size labels, clothing tags, brands, logos, watermarks, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩穿著或拿著一件明顯太大的新衣服，袖子或衣身太長，主角媽媽在旁邊看著，準備帶去修改。可有量衣服的軟尺或針線工具，但不能有尺寸數字或文字。人物身份：主角小女孩 + 主角媽媽。畫面重點是「新衣服太大，需要改」。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L226-S04 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. In a school classroom, protagonist little girl realizes she took the wrong textbook; a female classmate holds a different plain textbook, and the two girls are preparing to exchange the books back.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink hair clip and pink outerwear; female classmate is a different child with a bob haircut, yellow cardigan, and blue backpack, clearly not the protagonist. L058 is style reference only.
Composition: centered book exchange, two different plain book covers shown by color and simple abstract patterns only, desks in background, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor children's school illustration.
Avoid: no text, numbers, subject names, personal names, school names, cover writing, blackboard writing, labels, logos, watermarks, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在學校教室裡發現自己拿錯課本，旁邊有女同學也拿著另一本文本外觀不同的課本，兩人準備把課本換回來。課本封面不能有文字、科目、姓名或數字，只能用顏色或圖案區分兩本不同的課本。人物身份：主角小女孩 + 女同學。不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L226-S05 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl stands in a safe area outside a school entrance and recognizes the new teacher's car; the new teacher stands near the car or walks toward it.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; new teacher uses teacher identity and must not look like protagonist mother, with short tied-back dark hair, rectangular glasses, teal cardigan over a pale yellow top, dark skirt or trousers, distinct face and silhouette. L058 is style reference only.
Composition: centered girl, new teacher, and plain car, school entrance background without writing, safe margins for square crop.
Style: warm watercolor children's school illustration, calm and friendly.
Avoid: no car plate, numbers, school name, signs, logos, labels, badges, text, watermarks, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在校門口或學校外安全區域，看見新老師的車，表情像是認得那是新老師的車。新老師可以站在車旁或正在走向車，必須使用 teacher identity，不能像主角媽媽。車上不可有車牌文字、數字、校名、標誌或標籤。人物身份：主角小女孩 + 新老師。
